ability.value:
On first summon, summon a fledgling creation on any friendly creature, giving it stats and an ability by spending creation counters from a pool of 15.
(1 counter) 1 bar of any stat (cannot exceed 7 bars)
(1 counter) gives protectee +1 DEF while alive.
(2 counters) attacks inflict 1 stack of (soft/smeckeldorfed/thinned) for 2 turns.
(3 counters) attacks inflict 1 stack of (burdened/enfeebled/smoldering) for 2 turns.
(3 counters) persists on the field.
(3 counters) immune to tier 1 debuffs (+2 counters) and tier 2.
(4 counters) Intercept an attack directed at the protectee (+3 counters) any attack instead.
(4 counters) attacks are peircing.
(5 counters) (OPT) summon a fledgling minion on the same field as this.
fledgling creation (non-protective) 2/2/2/2 Ability is chosen by the summoner.
fledgling minion (non-protective) 1/2/3/4 (summoned by fledgling creation)
